messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Service SLO trigger for /v1/generate — p99 latency 2300ms (threshold 2000ms). Alert id: alert-9876. Link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/9876

rachael: noticing a spike in p99s across a couple hosts in us-west-2. looks correlated with the synthetic-load job that started at 10:12. no increase in 5xxs so far.

sam: thanks — is this customer-impacting or internal-only?

mike: checked traces, error rate steady, tail latency up on batchy workloads only. I think customer facing latency might see a few slow responses for large-context requests but nothing widespread.

rachael: agree. propose we put a temporary SLO suppression for the alert (30m) and route pages to secondary oncall to reduce noise during the experiment window. will also add a note to the runbook.

priya: ok — please include the runbook link and the exact suppression command so infra can audit. also cc:security if we touch routing.

rachael: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/slo-noise-mitigation — includes checklist for suppression, traffic routing, and rollback. suppression command I used:

```
# ops CLI
redwood-ops alerts suppress --id alert-9876 \
  --until 2024-07-22T12:30:00Z \
  --reason "synthetic-load test causing transient p99 spikes" \
  --note "on-call handoff: rachael -> sam; temp suppression to avoid noisy pages"
```

rachael: also updated PagerDuty routing to send primary -> sam, secondary -> mike for the next 2h. command shown below (auditable in infra logs):

```
# pseudo-yaml snippet applied
pagerduty:
  service: inference-api
  routing_override:
    until: 2024-07-22T12:30:00Z
    primary: sam
    secondary: mike
```

joni: added a short handoff note to the schedule: "sam primary, mike secondary, suppression in place until 12:30Z" — saved in oncall/shift-notes.

sam: I'll take primary. will watch alert stream and only escalate if we see errors or customer reports. will update channel every 15m.

mike: standing by as secondary. if primary needs to sleep, I can take over.

priya: quick customer-impact assessment: prod errors unchanged, latency spike limited to large-context routes under synthetic job. recommended: suppression + monitor, do not modify config of underlying model yet.

rachael: thanks. I'll keep suppression window conservative (30m) and remove early if noisy stops. if p99 remains high after suppression ends we escalate to infra/serving to investigate kernel-selection or queueing issues.

sam: ack. starting watch now. first update in ~15m. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: note: suppression created by rachael (alert-9876-suppress-20240722-1). Audit trail: https://alerts.redwood.internal/audit/alert-9876-suppress-20240722-1

rachael: closing thread for operational handoff — leaving the channel open for updates. if anyone sees customer tickets, tag #customer-impact and @priya.

sam: received.
